note: Photo prompts for the NAPE 2026 pictures that are still pending (image-generation allowance was exhausted). Generate 16:9, save as WebP (cwebp -q 84, ~1344 px wide) to public/media/puzzles/nape/<file>, then run: npm run media:manifest; node scripts/build-nape-meta.mjs; node scripts/build-event-order.mjs; npm run validate. Every prompt forbids text, logos and labels so nothing can give an answer away. Review each image at full size before keeping it.
suffix: No text, no logos, no watermark, no captions, no labels.

images.q07-ppe.webp: Professional photograph of an oil and gas worker standing on an industrial site, wearing a white hard hat, clear safety glasses, orange hi-vis coveralls with reflective stripes, work gloves and steel-toe safety boots, pipework in the background, full body visible, face turned slightly away.
images.q13-microfossils.webp: Scientific microscope photograph of microfossil foraminifera: many tiny chambered calcium-carbonate shells in varied coiled shapes clustered on a dark background, centered, macro detail, realistic. No scale bar.
images.q15-refinery.webp: Professional wide photograph of a large modern oil refinery at dusk with tall distillation columns, pipe racks, flare stacks and storage tanks lit up, sharp detail.
images.q18-ladder.webp: Professional photograph looking up at a worker in hard hat and safety harness climbing a vertical steel ladder on an offshore oil platform, sea and sky behind, correct climbing posture.
images.q24-flare-stack.webp: Professional photograph of a tall gas flare stack burning with an orange flame against a deep dusk sky, flare centered, industrial plant silhouette below, sharp detail.
images.q29-confined-space.webp: Professional photograph of a circular steel manway hatch on an industrial storage tank, a worker in coveralls, hard hat and harness beside it with a portable gas tester held toward the opening, a second worker standing by as attendant, safety barrier, realistic.
images.q56-derrick.webp: Professional photograph of a tall steel lattice drilling derrick of a land drilling rig against a blue sky, seen from ground level, centered, sharp detail.
images.q61-extinguishers.webp: Professional close-up photograph of a row of different fire extinguishers (red bodies, one with a horn-shaped discharge nozzle) mounted on an industrial plant wall, shallow depth of field.
images.q74-drill-bit.webp: Close-up studio-style photograph of a steel tricone roller-cone drill bit with tungsten carbide teeth on a workshop surface, sharp detail, centered.
images.q76-niger-delta.webp: Aerial photograph of a river delta: a vast network of winding creeks and rivers through dense green mangrove forest with a few small fishing canoes, hazy morning light, wide view.
images.q77-ear-defenders.webp: Professional photograph of a worker wearing yellow ear defenders and a hard hat in a noisy industrial plant, side profile view, pipework blurred behind.
images.q78-lng-tanker.webp: Professional photograph of a large LNG carrier ship with spherical tanks moored at an LNG terminal at sunset, sharp detail.
